messages:
Rina (Docs): heads-up: I'm adding a compact "Private deployment" subsection to the Regions page. Need a very short curl + Node + Python example that shows how to specify region/residency when talking to a private control plane. Also found two stale anchors to fix.
Dev (Platform): For private installs we prefer X-Redwood-Region header. Fallbacks: ?region query param and client config. Add a note about replacing the host with your control-plane URL.
Rina (Docs): ok I'll include header + query param example. Can you drop minimal snippets? Keep them <6 lines.
Omar (Eng): curl:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-4x","input":"test"}' \ 
  https://PRIVATE-CTRLPLANE.local/v1/responses
```
Omar (Eng): Node:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, region: 'eu' });
const r = await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-4x', input: 'hi' });
console.log(r.output[0].content[0].text);
```
Omar (Eng): Python:
```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'), region='eu')
print(client.responses.create(model='redwood-4x', input='hi'))
```
Dev (Platform): Note: if org residency is enforced (e.g. EU-only), headers/query params won't bypass policy. Callout to SRE for exceptions. Also use residency token 'eu' in examples, not cloud region names.
Priya (Legal): +1 to the policy note. Add a link to /docs/compliance/data-residency and to the DPA paragraph.
Rina (Docs): Will patch links. Found anchors: /docs/regions#private and /docs/setup#onprem-deploy both 404 after restructure. I'll fix in the PR.
docs-bot: lint/link-check running for PR #4960.
Rina (Docs): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4960 includes: private deployment residency snippet, curl/node/python samples, anchor fixes, legal callout.
Dev (Platform): I'll review; may push mapping for older SDKs to accept region query param. Add note in PR about backward compatibility.
Omar (Eng): tiny nit: use model name redwood-instruct-4x in examples to match public docs.
Rina (Docs): swapped model name. Updated host placeholder guidance: "replace PRIVATE-CTRLPLANE.local with your control-plane host".
docs-bot: link-check found 1 broken anchor: /docs/setup#onprem-deploy (line 67).
Rina (Docs): patched that anchor in the branch. Re-running checks.
